_commentaire: Manifeste du module anglais lakour-warcraft-en (engendré par outils/fabriquer-warcraft.mjs --langue en) : ce qui change par rapport à modules/lakour-warcraft/module.json. Le reste (version, auteurs, adresses, compatibilité, système, scripts, langues, packs et leurs droits, quickstart et listes de sorts récrits) est repris du manifeste français.
title: La Kour Warcraft — Azeroth for 5th edition
description: Azeroth for 5th edition (dnd5e system, 2024 rules), in English: thirteen playable species, ten backgrounds, thirteen subclasses, feats, affiliations, spells, an arsenal, afflictions, professions and a crafting bench, a faction garrison, reputations and contracts, mounts, a bestiary of seventy stat blocks. A starter adventure (levels 1 to 3), a four-chapter campaign (3 to 6), an investigation one-shot, a three-boss dungeon and ready-to-play maps, each importable in one click. The house rules are automated (auras, the ranger's companion, totems, boss phase 2, fury, item sets) and five seasonal festivals bring the Barrens to life with the companion AI GM module. Original texts; unofficial fan work, not affiliated with Blizzard Entertainment. — English edition of the French module lakour-warcraft: same documents, same identifiers; do not enable both at once. Any text not yet translated appears in French.
